g.text: The address probe does not predict the lookup's errors
Varied scenes, unedited, where the lookup answers wrong. (a) Wrong answers whose locker the address
probe predicts (%); (b) of those, the lens's top item at the bridge word still the right item (%). 95%
intervals, fixed in advance; a model with fewer than 30 wrong answers is not tested.
9B does not predict; 27B not tested; Muse pending; Lightning does not predict (hollow); 122B not run.
Hollow marks: Lightning's gate chosen after the 60-scene pre-check was seen.
